learning_pass.validation_rule: A method is not promoted because it sounds correct. It must change a work contract or experiment, survive a real artifact test, and leave durable accept/reject evidence.

preserved_user_requirements: Optimize for growth, IP/audience asset, advertiser invitations and sustainable commercialization rather than platform incentive payments.
Default to zero or very low incremental cost and no recurring filming requirement, while keeping final visual quality as the first priority.
Use free or low-cost production paths where they clear the quality threshold; escalate to premium engines only where the artifact requires them.
Primary commercial axis: AI applications/software/SaaS, 3C/smart hardware, technology business/frontier technology and adjacent sponsor pools.
Content must stand on its own before sponsor integration.
Final QA must consume the real rendered media; code success or agent self-report is not sufficient.
The studio must proactively scout superior works, tools, Skills, source and community workflows instead of waiting for the user to provide them.
Quality-critical full builds must be preceded by a representative near-final sample; a technical demo cannot authorize production.
Use GitHub video-growth-agent main as executable business authority; Notion/Library are recovery/evidence mirrors, not business-rule authority.
Every specialist role must actually execute its assigned loss function and leave evidence; role definitions alone do not count as execution.
The system must expose its own capability and governance failures instead of smoothing them over in aggregate self-review.
